faq.heroSubtitle: Straightforward answers regarding rates, delivery timelines, payment terms, and working directly with Saad M.

faqsList.question: What is your standard rate and how do payments work?
faqsList.answer: My standard rate is £35/hour. For defined projects, I offer fixed milestone packages (e.g. 50% deposit upon start, 50% upon successful launch). All prices are completely transparent with zero hidden fees.

faqsList.question: How long does it take to build a website?
faqsList.answer: A standard 5-page business website typically takes 1 to 2 weeks. E-commerce shops take roughly 2 to 3 weeks. Express rush delivery is also available if you have an urgent launch deadline.

faqsList.question: Can I easily edit words and prices myself after launch?
faqsList.answer: Yes! Every project includes a personalized video walkthrough showing you exactly how to edit text, update prices, or add new photos yourself anytime without needing to write code.

faqsList.question: Do you provide website hosting and domain setup?
faqsList.answer: Yes, I handle connecting your domain, setting up high-speed cloud hosting, free SSL security locks, and automated daily backups.
